verdict.rationale: Edge0 can run without a UI: a CLI `edge0 serve` command exposes an OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint that can be scripted with curl. It also offers a one-shot chat CLI with flags like --max-new, a Python AutoEngine API, scripted model fetching, a benchmark script driven by an env var, a macOS daemon mode, and a pytest suite that needs no real weights. Missing for 10: explicit CI/automation documentation or examples (e.g. pipeline configs, exit-code/non-interactive behavior), clarity on headless support for typical Linux/CUDA CI runners (CUDA is only a reserved slot), and independent hands-on corroboration.
